query_text: Where can I find the latest news about the stock market?

action.query: latest stock market news Reuters markets
queries: latest stock market news Reuters markets
latest stock market news CNBC markets
latest stock market news Bloomberg markets

content.text:
For **latest stock market news**, these are good places to check:

- **Reuters Markets** — fast, factual market-moving news and global coverage. ([investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/shares-hesitant-after-us-jobs-data-oil-jumps-on-venezuela-blockade-4411720?utm_source=openai))  
- **Bloomberg Markets** — strong for real-time market data, bonds, currencies, commodities, and institutional coverage. ([bloomberg.com](https://www.bloomberg.com/markets?utm_source=openai))  
- **CNBC Markets** — accessible live market updates, premarket coverage, and TV clips.  
- **The Wall Street Journal – Markets** — deeper analysis on U.S. stocks, Fed policy, earnings, and investor sentiment. ([wsj.com](https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks/s-p-500-hovers-near-record-with-wall-street-hoping-for-a-year-end-rally-53cf6057?utm_source=openai))  
- **MarketWatch** — good for retail-investor-friendly headlines, indexes, and portfolio-related news.  
- **Yahoo Finance** — useful for free quotes, watchlists, earnings calendars, and headline aggregation.  
- **Investing.com** — good for futures, commodities, economic calendars, and global market data.

If you want **real-time prices**, use a brokerage app, TradingView, Yahoo Finance, CNBC, or Bloomberg. If you want **serious news analysis**, Reuters, Bloomberg, WSJ, and Financial Times are usually stronger.
